title: The Patience That Outlasted Grief
intro: An elder whose patience became legendary, whose vision faded from sorrow, yet whose faith in the divine plan never wavered. This individual watched twelve sons grow into the foundations of tribes, suffered the painful loss of a most beloved child, and became a timeless symbol of beautiful patience in the face of overwhelming grief. A revered soul whose story is told across the pages of revelation. Can you identify this figure from the Quran?
clues: I was a prophet whose story is told in detail within a major surah of the Quran.
I had twelve sons who became the fathers of the tribes of Bani Israel.
I told my sons to enter through different gates, lest they be recognized as a single people.
My eyes whitened from ceaseless weeping over a beloved child taken from me.
I refused to despair even when my other sons urged me to, saying I only complain to Allah.
I am the father of the prophet Yusuf, whose very name means 'the augmenter' in Arabic.

identity.label: Who Am I?
options: Prophet Yaqub (Jacob)
Prophet Yusuf
Prophet Ibrahim
Prophet Musa
Prophet Dawud

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Loss of a beloved son to a well
The great flood that engulfed an entire people
The migration from a fire-worshipping kingdom
The confrontation with a mighty tyrant of Egypt
The exile to a whale's belly
trial.answer: Loss of a beloved son to a well

location.label: Key Element
options: A shirt stained with false blood
A staff that turned into a serpent
An ark built on a mountain
A she-camel carved from rock
A golden calf
location.answer: A shirt stained with false blood

outcome.label: Outcome
options: Sight restored when a beloved son's shirt was placed over the face
Salvation after being cast into the belly of a great fish
Receiving the title of Khalilullah from Allah
Crossing the sea with a people freed from bondage
A rainbow appearing as a sign of hope after the flood
outcome.answer: Sight restored when a beloved son's shirt was placed over the face

arabic: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَشْكُوا۟ بَثِّى وَحُزْنِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verse: He said, "I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allāh, and I know from Allāh that which you do not know. (12:86)
